definitions.explanation: Pleasantly warm; describing freshly cooked food or warm feelings.

examples.japanese: ほかほかの{焼|や}きたてパンを{食|た}べた。
examples.english: I ate freshly baked, warm bread.

examples.japanese: {体|からだ}がほかほかしてきた。
examples.english: My body started to feel warm.

examples.japanese: ほかほかの{御飯|ごはん}が{食|た}べたい。
examples.english: I want to eat steaming hot rice.

notes: A pleasant onomatopoeia describing comfortable warmth. Often used for freshly cooked food. Related to the store name ほっかほっか{亭|てい} (bento chain). Evokes a cozy, satisfying feeling.
